posts.title: SVS SoundPath Multi-Band Wireless Audio Adapter
posts.description: SVS just announced a really neat product that should help out anyone who rents, or can’t run wires through the walls, and also wants to BYO subwoofer to the wireless party. The most important thing to understand about this device is that it only carries the audio, it is not an amplifier, so it won’t work with just any speaker. posts.title: Level 1 Charging – Can and Should aren’t the same thing…
posts.description: Every now and again I run across some EV evangelist pushing the narrative that Level 1 (120V) charging is plenty fine, good enough, blah blah blah. OK, so, they are kind of right but not in the way that makes the EV experience “better” than what most people would experience with an ICE vehicle.
